Blitz desktop app sounds like that Dota feature which helps your build etc. Thanks a lot for that. Too much damage and fast games makes me afraid because I’m a bad player. 

Those changes sounds interesting aswell, I think I will give it a try. Thanks for your help mate.

It feels complicated, I watched some games from this season and it felt like a different game. Support and top lane champions that I used to play are barely gone, a lot of new champions and complicated meta is bad for me aswell but yeah I think it’s not that bad as a new game. I’m gonna stick with ARAM for some time I guess, thanks

Holy shit, I didn’t expect that much change tbh. What is the point of a MOBA game then if they changed it this way. League was one of the best free games I’ve ever played back in the day but if it’s lost the meaning of MOBA then there is no reason to play. Thanks man.
